;R.text:
- The name of the Backdrop costume is important. 
  Make sure the boss sprite, the level's costume for "Platform", and the 
  level's costume for "Platforms" are the same name as the backdrop 
  costume you are using for the boss fight.

- "Boss Phase Thresholds" is a list that decides the phase of the boss

- The name of death cards are structured as the first three letters 
  of the backdrop name, plus the current phase of the fight

  Example:
  If the name of the backdrop is "Slime Boss," then the death card 
  for phase 1 will be named "Sli1"


- More tips and guides are in
"Status Effects"
"Particle Effects"
"Demo Boss"
"Projectile Example"
and "Enemy"

/K.text:
Each list block with a number equates to a phase of the fight. In this example, there are three phases to the fight. 

Reminder to end this section like this - 
add 0 to Boss Phase Thresholds
add end to Boss Phase Thresholds

"add 0" will be the last phase, if you want only one phase, only have these two.

/J.text: Boss health is important to get right as too little will result in skipped content, and too much can drag the fight out and make it boring. Consider the number of phases, the complexity of the phases, and how often you can hit the boss.

/Q.text: Make sure when going between phases to have this activate once per phase clear.

:d.text:
Tool to use for animation
1 - The frame the animation you want to show starts on
2 - The frame rate, how fast you want it to go through the costumes.
3 - How many frames are in this animation, if it goes over, it will loop back to the first frame.
